gold.user: A developer wants to retrieve a list of all indexes in the Meilisearch instance to understand the current data structure and available search options.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON array of index objects, each containing details like indexUid, name, and number of documents.

gold.user: A data engineer is looking to create a new index for a dataset containing product information to enable efficient searching and filtering.
gold.ideal: The API should return a success message along with the details of the newly created index, including its indexUid.

gold.user: A product manager needs to check the configuration and status of a specific index to ensure it is set up correctly for the upcoming product launch.
gold.ideal: The API should return the details of the specified index, including its schema, settings, and document count.

gold.user: A backend developer wants to update the settings of an existing index to improve search performance and relevance based on user feedback.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the update and return the updated settings of the index.

gold.user: An administrator needs to remove an outdated index that is no longer in use to clean up the Meilisearch instance and free up resources.
gold.ideal: The API should return a success message indicating that the index has been successfully removed.

gold.user: A DevOps engineer is performing a deployment and needs to swap the current index with a new version to ensure zero downtime for users.
gold.ideal: The API should return a confirmation of the swap operation along with the details of the indexes that were swapped.
